leadText:
Old Man Dom (Japanese: ダムじいさん Grandpa Dam) is a recurring character who first appeared in Hoopa — The Mischief Pokémon. He is a farmer living in Arche Valley.

In Hoopa and the Clash of Ages, Old Man Dom was taking a nap on a chair in the middle of the day, when Meray pranked him by having replace his own hat with a hat. She was scolded for this by her brother Baraz who had her and Hoopa apologize to Old Man Dom.

A few years later, in Hoopa — The Mischief Pokémon, Old Man Dom was plowing his field and wishing for some rain to come, when he was surprised by Hoopa, who had a huge amount of candy rain down on him. Realizing that the candy came from 's store and that Baraz, Meray, Lucianne, Pit and Kevie were responsible for this, he angrily made them return all the candy.
